```{r}
outputdir <- "./figs/"
if(!dir.exists(outputdir)){
  dir.create(outputdir)
}

ggsave2_tri <- function(plot, wid = 9, hei=9){
  plot_name <- deparse(substitute(plot))
  
  #png
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".png", sep = "",collapse = "")
  ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "png",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  
  #pdf
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pdf", sep = "",collapse = "")
  # ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "pdf",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  #pptx
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pptx", sep = "",collapse = "")
  plot_ed <- rvg::dml(ggobj = plot,width = wid, height = hei)
  
  doc <- read_pptx() %>%
    add_slide('Title and Content', 'Office Theme') %>%
    ph_with(value = "", location = ph_location_type(type = "title")) %>%
    ph_with(value = plot_ed, location = ph_location(type = "body",width = cm2inch(wid), height = cm2inch(hei),left = 2, top = 2))
  doc %>%
    print(target = file_name)
  
}



inch2cm <- function(x){
  return(x/0.39370)
}
cm2inch <- function(x){
  return(0.39370*x)
}

p2cm <- function(x){
  return(as.integer(0.008466666666666667 * x))
}

cm2p <- function(x){
  return(as.integer(118.11023622047244 *x))
}
```

```{r}
# 正常範囲の定義
cutoff_values <- list(
  RESP = c(12, 24),
  TEMPR = c(36, 38.4),
  PULSE = c(70, 109),
  BPM = c(70, 109))

df_cutoff_values <- cutoff_values %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(name = rownames(.)) %>% 
  `colnames<-`(c("lower_limit", "upper_limit", "name")) %>% 
  mutate(median_of_range = (lower_limit+upper_limit)/2) %>% 
  mutate(range_of_safe = upper_limit - median_of_range)

df_cutoff_values
```


```{r}
ij_coef <- 1e+6

max_i <- 500

 # lag_dt, lead_dt, delta_obs_time,
df_j <- left_join(df_vit,
                  df_icu_target %>% 
                    dplyr::select(PT_ID, JIPAD_ID, ADM_DT),
                by = c("PT_ID"="PT_ID"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(sub_DT=ADM_DT-dt) %>% 
  filter(sub_DT>=0) %>% 
  # mutate(in_24h=sub_DT<=24*60*60) %>% 
  # mutate(in_48h=sub_DT<=48*60*60) %>% 
  # mutate(in_96h=sub_DT<=96*60*60) %>%
  # dplyr::filter(in_96h) %>%
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, dt, sub_DT, everything()) %>%
tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c("PULSE", "RESP", "BPL", "BPH", "BPM", "TEMPR")) %>%
  filter(value!=0) %>%
  # filter(name %in% c("PULSE", "BPM")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_cutoff_values, by = "name") %>% 
  # filter(name == "PULSE") %>%
  filter(!name %in% c("BPL", "BPH")) %>%
  filter((name == "RESP" & value<=50 & value>=1) | name != "RESP") %>%
  # mutate(abn_value = case_when(
  #   upper_limit<value ~ abs(value - upper_limit),
  #   value<lower_limit ~ abs(lower_limit - value),
  #   T ~ 0
  # )) %>% 
  mutate(abn_value = (value -median_of_range) %>% 
           abs()) %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  mutate(sd_name = sd(abn_value),
         abn_value_std = abn_value/range_of_safe) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(JIPAD_ID, PT_ID, ADM_DT, dt, sub_DT, name, value, abn_value,abn_value_std) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(JIPAD_ID) %>% 
  arrange(JIPAD_ID, dt) %>% 
  mutate(hour = sub_DT/3600) %>%
  mutate(hrs = as.numeric(hour)) %>%
  filter(hrs < 72) %>% 
  mutate(dt_num = as.numeric(dt)) %>% 
  mutate(lag_dt = lag(dt),
         lag_dt_num = as.numeric(lag_dt),
         delta_obs_num = dt_num - lag_dt_num,
         delta_obs_time = (dt - lag_dt) %>% 
           as.numeric())  %>% 
  mutate(lead_dt = lead(dt),
         lead_dt_num = as.numeric(lead_dt),
         next_obs_num = dt_num - lead_dt_num,
         next_obs_time = (dt - lead_dt_num) %>% 
           as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(delta_obs_time_cmp = if_else(delta_obs_num ==0, NA, delta_obs_num) %>% 
           vctrs::vec_fill_missing(., direction = "down") %>% 
           if_else(is.na(.), 0, .) %>% 
           magrittr::divide_by(3600) %>% 
           magrittr::divide_by(24)) %>% 
  mutate(next_obs_time_cmp = if_else(next_obs_num ==0, NA, next_obs_num) %>%
           vctrs::vec_fill_missing(., direction = "up") %>%
           magrittr::divide_by(3600) %>%
           magrittr::divide_by(24) %>% 
           magrittr::multiply_by(-1) %>% 
           if_else(is.na(.), hrs, .)
         ) %>%
  mutate(ind_j = factor(dt) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ind_i = factor(JIPAD_ID) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  #pt ind filtering
  # filter(ind_i == 9) %>% 
  # mutate(ind_i = factor(JIPAD_ID) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(ind_ij = ((ij_coef * ind_i) + ind_j) %>% 
           factor() %>% 
           as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(ind_k = factor(name) %>% 
           as.numeric())  %>% 
  filter(ind_i <= max_i)


df_j %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  summarise(sd_name = sd(abn_value_std))
#   filter(ind_i %in% c(1, 9))
# %>% 
#   # filter(ind_i %in% c(9,10))
  # group_by(JIPAD_ID, dt, name) %>% 
  # mutate(n=n()) %>% 
  # filter(n!=1)
  # summarise(n=n())
  
  
  # mutate(hour = sub_DT/3600) %>% 
  # mutate(hrs = as.numeric(hour)) %>% 
  # mutate(hrs_int = round(hrs)) %>%
  # # not input date -> MEASURED_DATE
  # group_by(PT_ID, name, MEASURED_DATE) %>% 
  # mutate(vit_mes_count = n()) %>%
  # filter(hrs < 168) %>% 
  # # filter(hrs < 48) %>% 
  # # after ICU admission, vit count may over 36 in same date. so this filtering is not apropriate. removed.
  # # filter(vit_mes_count <= 36) %>%
  # filter((name == "RESP" & value<=50 & value>=1) | name != "RESP") %>%
  # mutate(nhrs = -hrs)

df_j_ijdt <- df_j %>% 
  dplyr::select(ind_i, ind_j, ind_ij, delta_obs_time_cmp,hrs) %>% 
  distinct()
```

```{r}
append_list <- function(l, x){
  xname  <- deparse(substitute(x))
  l[[xname]] <- x
  return(l)
}

# load function
get_vals <- function(l){
  lnames <- names(l)
  for(n in lnames){
    assign(n, l[[n]], pos = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  return(lnames)
}
```
